Mountain Travel: Best Places to Visit
From the Andes to the Zagros mountains, this new board is a place to showcase these large and timeless landforms that stand tall across the world and never cease to inspire us. If you've been invited to pin to this board please keep the pins solely to mountain images and add any geographic information you can. Also, please ensure where possible that the source online from where the image is pinned, notes the proper attribution to the original photographer. No more than 3 pins per day.
